description: The identical function RETURNING the binding it declared. Same declaration form, same scope — only the use is added, which is exactly the condition the code keys on.
rationale: §35 — a must-use binding is one whose VALUE is the point of computing it; letting it fall out of scope unread is, with near-certainty, either a forgotten use or a dead computation. scrml makes that loud rather than silent, and gives an explicit opt-out (`_`-prefix) so the author can SAY "computed for effect, value deliberately unused" instead of leaving the reader to guess.
